headline: Customers to get an inflation shock: petrol up ₹5, diesel up ₹3; this big company has raised petrol and diesel prices. Customers will face another shock. Petrol 5 rupees, diesel 3 rupees. This company has increased prices
summary: Jio-bp has raised petrol prices by ₹5 per litre and diesel by ₹3 per litre, effective Sunday. Petrol in Punjab is now about ₹108.54 per litre and diesel about ₹99.19.
why: Jio-bp is a retail fuel joint venture between Reliance Industries and BP that sells petrol and diesel in India. Its pricing changes shape fuel demand and margins in the Indian retail fuel market.
